name: Numbers API
tagline: Trivia, math, date, and year facts for any number—long-running novelty staple.
description: A free, no-authentication HTTP API that returns interesting trivia, mathematical properties, historical dates, and year facts for any integer. Long-running staple of developer demos and educational apps; supports plain text and JSON responses with optional fragments and default fallbacks when no fact is known.

auth.details: No authentication required. Public endpoints accept unauthenticated GET requests; optional JSON via Accept header or query param.

pricing.free_tier_limits: unlimited free public use (no published quota); no paid plans

example.response_snippet: {"text":"42 is the answer to the Ultimate Question of Life, the Universe, and Everything.","number":42,"found":true,"type":"trivia"}

use_cases: get a trivia fact for a number
fetch math properties of an integer
get historical facts for a calendar date
add random number facts to a demo or chatbot
